spike_verdict: The end dates carry 'by 1966': Dreamland burned 1911 (H085, H120); Luna Park burned Aug 13, 1944 and closed 1944 or 1946 (H103, P001, conflict 37); Steeplechase closed Sept 20, 1964 (N028, P006) and was demolished in 1966 (P010, single high-confidence source; Untapped gives no year). But 'made Coney Island famous' is not stated by any fact, and the Luna end date is given two ways inside one section.

blocking.problem: No sheet fact says the three parks made the place famous. P006 only says Steeplechase was 'the last of the three big amusement parks'.
